query:
WITH '<namespace_here>' as namespace
MATCH p = (n:Namespace)-[:EndpointsWithSelector]->(s)-[:Egress]->(f)
WHERE n.displayname = namespace
  AND NOT (f)-[:ToPorts]->(:Port)
RETURN p
LIMIT 1000
name: Cilium Namespace - Egress To Any Port (EndpointSelecter)
description: Egress from endpoint selectors to any TCP/UDP port for a specific namespace
